notes: Local Windows qualification is the first milestone proven end-to-end on real infrastructure rather than fixtures. What it added beyond M1-M9: transactional journaled deployment with verified-stop and symmetric restart; ACL correctness as part of the state write primitive (ADR-0029); the identity verb so PowerShell never touches key material (ADR-0030); schema-safe optional-property accessors and proof-based broker reuse (ADR-0031); a machine-readable child protocol that cannot lose a committed rotation; and a permanent secret-shape scanner. Next: REAL_CLOUD_BRINGUP - GitHub private repo + CI (after gh auth), Tailscale enrollment both ends, Hetzner provisioning from infra/opentofu, Cloud Core deployed on the production database model, agent switched from loopback to the tailnet endpoint WITHOUT reinstall/reenroll, then the full remote command path and resilience matrix.
